item.name: Get Self Student Attendance (Subject Wise, Semester)

query.description: Optional. Omit to use the logged-in student's current semester.

request.description: Student role only. Subject-wise attendance for one semester. Each subject includes total_classes, attended_classes, leave_classes, and percentage. A record status is leave when that class was absent on an approved leave date.

Staff or faculty only. The first call checks in and stores status present. Check-out is optional: a missing check-out still counts as present. There is no late or half-day status. A second call on the same day only sets check_out.

Staff or faculty punch history plus summary.present, summary.absent, summary.leave, and summary.percentage. A stored late status is returned as present. Missing check_out stays present. summary.leave counts approved leave dates with no present punch, excluding Sundays and holidays. A present punch on a leave date stays present. Percentage is present / (present + absent).
Demo seeder values: LLB3 course, batch 2024-27, session 2024-25, Semester I, Section A (students ROLL-001..005).
Marks attendance for demo students ROLL-001 and ROLL-002 (user ids from AttendanceDemoSeeder).

Staff or faculty only. One student's subject-wise list plus overall percentage for the selected semester. summary and subject_wise include leave_classes. A record status is leave when that class was absent on an approved leave date. Percentage is present / (present + absent). Leave is outside that total.

Staff or faculty only. Each class row includes present_count, absent_count, and leave_count. absent_count does not include students who are absent or unmarked on an approved leave. Those students are in leave_count. Present stays present.

item.name: Get Faculty Attendance Summary Students List

request.description: Staff or faculty only. Each student status is present, absent, or leave. Present stays present. Absent, or no class mark, on an approved leave date is leave. A normal absent day stays absent.
